title: The wand
starting_code:
# Walk to the flat stone.
# Pick up the wand.
# Walk on to Nuri.
hints: Walk three steps to the right to reach the stone.
Use the `pick_up` action to take the wand.
Take three more steps to the right to reach me.
intro: I went ahead and set my spare wand on that flat stone for you. I will lend it to you, and you will give it back to me one day!
outro: You have a wand! Now you can do some real magic.
learned: Now you know about things to carry, which are objects too.
